ex.en: Turn on two-factor authentication to protect your account.
ex.zh: 開啟雙重驗證來保護你的帳號。

ex.en: The app uses fingerprint authentication.
ex.zh: 這個 App 使用指紋驗證。

authentication.en: the process of proving who someone is or that something is real

ex.en: Automation has replaced many factory jobs.
ex.zh: 自動化取代了許多工廠的工作。

ex.zh: 我們用自動化的方式寄送提醒郵件。

automation.en: the use of machines to do work without people

ex.en: You are not authorized to enter there.
ex.zh: 你沒有權限進入那裡。

ex.zh: 你真的批准司機把車開回家嗎？

ex.zh: 只有經理可以批准退款。

authorize.en: to give official permission for something

ex.zh: 中國衛生當局正在採取措施阻止冠狀病毒擴散。

ex.zh: 要進入這棟大樓，必須取得當局的許可。

ex.zh: 地方當局已經封閉了這條路。

authority.en: the people or groups with official power over an area

ex.zh: 你憑什麼要我們走？

ex.zh: 只有經理有權核准這件事。

authority.en: the power to give orders and make decisions

ex.en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
ex.zh: 那位醫生是兒童疾病的權威。

ex.zh: 他是經濟學的權威。

authority.en: a person who knows a lot about a subject

ex.en: This factory produces 500 automobiles a day.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每天生產五百輛汽車。

ex.en: Automobiles are made in factories.
ex.zh: 汽車是在工廠裡製造的。

ex.zh: 腳踏車在汽車右側行駛是違法的。

automobile.en: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels

auto.zh: 汽車（多用於修飾語，如 auto industry）

ex.en: He works in the auto industry.
ex.zh: 他在汽車業工作。

ex.zh: 汽車零件行就在加油站旁邊。

auto.en: short for a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels

ex.en: Set the camera to auto mode.
ex.zh: 把相機設為自動模式。

ex.zh: 開啟自動儲存，以免工作內容遺失。

auto.en: working by itself without a person controlling it

ex.en: Each day our life becomes more comfortable and more automated.
ex.zh: 我們的生活一天比一天更舒適、更自動化。

ex.en: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
ex.zh: 這是自動投幣式公用電話，投硬幣就可以打。

ex.en: We plan to automate the billing process.
ex.zh: 我們打算把請款流程自動化。

automate.en: to make a machine or process work without people doing it

ex.en: The doors at the entrance are automatic.
ex.zh: 入口的門是自動門。

ex.en: The system sends an automatic reply.
ex.zh: 系統會自動回覆。

automatic.en: working by itself without a person controlling it

ex.en: Saying 'thank you' has become automatic for him.
ex.zh: 說「謝謝」對他來說已經成了反射動作。

ex.en: Breathing is an automatic process.
ex.zh: 呼吸是一種自動進行的過程。

ex.en: I knew it would be hot in the auditorium.
ex.zh: 我就知道禮堂裡會很熱。

ex.en: The ceremony will be held in the school auditorium.
ex.zh: 典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

auditorium.en: a large hall or the seating area where an audience sits

ex.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣掉了。

ex.en: The painting sold at auction for a million dollars.
ex.zh: 這幅畫在拍賣會上以一百萬元售出。

auction.en: a public sale where things go to the person who offers the most money

ex.en: The unclaimed items were auctioned off.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣了。

ex.en: They auctioned the old furniture online.
ex.zh: 他們在網路上拍賣舊家具。

auction.en: to sell things at a public sale to the person who offers the most money

ex.en: I have an audition today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一場試鏡。

ex.en: She has an audition for a musical next week.
ex.zh: 她下週要參加一齣音樂劇的試鏡。

audition.en: a short test performance to try to win a part in a show

ex.en: He auditioned for the lead role.
ex.zh: 他去試鏡主角。

ex.en: Hundreds of singers auditioned for the show.
ex.zh: 數百名歌手參加了這個節目的試鏡。

audition.en: to give a short test performance to try to win a part

ex.en: He works in the automotive industry.
ex.zh: 他在汽車業工作。

ex.en: The company makes automotive parts for export.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產外銷的汽車零件。

automotive.en: relating to cars and other road vehicles

ex.en: Employees want more autonomy at work.
ex.zh: 員工希望工作上有更多自主權。

ex.en: Each branch has a degree of autonomy.
ex.zh: 每間分公司都有一定的自主權。

autonomy.en: the freedom to make your own decisions without control from others

autonomous.zh: 自主的、自治的；自動（駕駛）的

ex.en: Each department is autonomous in its hiring decisions.
ex.zh: 各部門在招聘上可以自行決定。

ex.en: Autonomous cars may become common within ten years.
ex.zh: 自動駕駛車可能在十年內普及。

autonomous.en: able to make decisions or act without being controlled by others

ex.zh: 這部影片的音質很差。

ex.en: Please check your audio settings before the online meeting.
ex.zh: 線上會議前請先檢查音訊設定。

ex.en: This book also comes with an audio version.
ex.zh: 這本書也有有聲版。

audio.en: relating to sound that is recorded or played back

ex.en: Richard Roberts is the author of numerous books.
ex.zh: 理查·羅伯茨寫了很多本書。

ex.en: I have read many modern authors.
ex.zh: 我讀過許多現代作家的作品。

ex.en: That Italian author is little known in Japan.
ex.zh: 那位義大利作家在日本不太有名。

author.en: a person who writes books or other texts

ex.en: If you press this button the window opens automatically.
ex.zh: 按下這個按鈕，窗戶就會自動打開。

ex.en: All plans automatically renew until cancelled.
ex.zh: 所有方案在取消前都會自動續約。

ex.en: My computer shut down automatically.
ex.zh: 我的電腦自動關機了。

automatically.en: by itself without a person controlling it

ex.en: I automatically reached for my phone when I woke up.
ex.zh: 我一醒來就下意識地去拿手機。

ex.en: She automatically said yes without thinking.
ex.zh: 她想都沒想就答應了。

automatically.en: without thinking about what you are doing

aunt.zh: 阿姨、姑姑、舅媽、伯母、嬸嬸

ex.en: This doll is a gift from my aunt.
ex.zh: 這個洋娃娃是我阿姨送我的禮物。

ex.en: My aunt made a new skirt for me.
ex.zh: 我阿姨幫我做了一條新裙子。

ex.en: My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在她的花園裡種番茄。

aunt.en: the sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle

ex.zh: 極光是極地特有的自然現象。

ex.zh: 我們飛到冰島看極光。

ex.zh: 極光把夜空染成一片綠色。

aurora.en: bands of colored light seen in the sky near the North or South Pole

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到了秋天會變紅或變黃。

ex.en: Autumn came and the leaves started to fall.
ex.zh: 秋天到了，樹葉也開始落下。

ex.en: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
ex.zh: 有些動物會在秋天為冬季儲藏食物。

autumn.en: the season between summer and winter

ex.en: The government introduced austerity measures to cut debt.
ex.zh: 政府推出撙節措施以減少債務。

ex.en: Many people protested against austerity.
ex.zh: 許多人抗議緊縮政策。

austerity.en: strict government policies to spend less money

ex.en: You need authorization to access this file.
ex.zh: 你需要授權才能存取這個檔案。

ex.en: No one may enter without written authorization.
ex.zh: 未經書面許可，任何人不得進入。

ex.en: The company has an audit every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年都要接受稽核。

ex.en: The audit found several errors in the accounts.
ex.zh: 稽核發現帳目有好幾處錯誤。

audit.en: an official check of a company's money records

ex.en: An outside firm audits our accounts.
ex.zh: 我們的帳目由外部公司查核。

ex.en: I'm auditing a history class this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期旁聽一門歷史課。

audit.en: to check a company's money records, or to attend a class without taking exams

ex.en: The auditors will visit our office next week.
ex.zh: 稽核人員下週會來我們辦公室。

ex.en: An independent auditor checked the accounts.
ex.zh: 一位獨立的查帳員檢查了帳目。

auditor.en: a person whose job is to check a company's money records

ex.en: The system keeps an audit trail of every payment.
ex.zh: 系統會保留每筆付款的稽核紀錄。

ex.zh: 稽核軌跡有助於調查人員追蹤變更。

audit trail.en: a record of all the actions taken, which can be checked later

ex.en: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?
ex.zh: 法國有道地的中餐廳嗎？

ex.zh: 我很希望可以說一口地道的中文。

authentic.en: real and true to its original style or culture

ex.en: Is this painting authentic?
ex.zh: 這幅畫是真跡嗎？

ex.en: The museum confirmed that the letter is authentic.
ex.zh: 博物館證實那封信是真的。

ex.zh: 所有的觀眾都站起來鼓掌。

ex.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
ex.zh: 觀眾大多是年紀很小的孩子。

ex.en: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.
ex.zh: 聽眾裡有學生、老師、上班族等等。

audience.en: the people who watch or listen to a show or talk

ex.en: Who is the target audience for this ad?
ex.zh: 這支廣告的目標族群是誰？

ex.en: Her videos have a large audience in Asia.
ex.zh: 她的影片在亞洲有廣大的觀眾。

audience.en: the group of people that a product or message is meant for

ex.en: We are going to Japan in August.
ex.zh: 我們八月要去日本。

ex.en: School starts at the end of August.
ex.zh: 學校在八月底開學。

ex.zh: 那座莊嚴的大廳掛滿了古老的畫作。

ex.en: He was an august figure in the town.
ex.zh: 他是鎮上一位德高望重的人物。

ex.zh: 澳洲既是一個國家，也是一塊大陸。

ex.zh: 袋鼠生活在澳洲的野外。

ex.zh: 我的室友是個熱愛衝浪的澳洲人。

ex.zh: 有幾位澳洲人加入了我們的健行團。

ex.zh: 她有濃厚的澳洲口音。

ex.zh: 我們在派對上嚐了一些澳洲葡萄酒。

ex.zh: 奧地利是中歐的一個國家。

ex.zh: 維也納是奧地利的首都。

ex.en: Only the manager can authorise this payment.
ex.zh: 只有經理能批准這筆付款。

ex.en: She authorised her assistant to sign the documents for her.
ex.zh: 她授權助理代她簽署文件。

ex.en: The school has authorised students to use the library after hours.
ex.zh: 學校已准許學生在下班時間使用圖書館。

ex.en: She wrote an autobiography about growing up on a farm.
ex.zh: 她寫了一本談農場成長經歷的自傳。

ex.zh: 我上週從圖書館借了他的自傳。

ex.zh: 這個國家被一個專制政府統治了數十年。

ex.zh: 有些人覺得專制型的父母太嚴格。

ex.zh: 我阿姨每年聖誕節都會烤餅乾。

ex.zh: 我們的姑姑住在城裡，夏天會來看我們。

ex.zh: 奧克蘭是紐西蘭最大的城市。

ex.zh: 我們上週從奧克蘭飛到雪梨。

ex.zh: 這家汽車製造商計畫明年推出一款新的電動車。

ex.zh: 有好幾家汽車製造商在這個地區設了工廠。

ex.zh: 這本書是亞洲鳥類最具權威的指南。

ex.zh: 分享消息之前，先查證可靠的權威來源。

ex.zh: 老師用冷靜而有威嚴的聲音說話。

ex.zh: 他威嚴的語氣讓大家都安靜聽著。

ex.zh: 驗屍結果顯示他是自然死亡。

ex.zh: 醫生進行驗屍以找出死因。

ex.zh: 她喜歡奧地利的巧克力和糕點。

ex.zh: 他們參觀了山裡的一座奧地利村莊。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Austrian who teaches music.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是一位教音樂的奧地利人。

ex.en: Many Austrians enjoy skiing in the winter.
ex.zh: 許多奧地利人冬天喜歡滑雪。

ex.en: The factory uses automated machines to pack boxes.
ex.zh: 工廠使用自動化機器來包裝箱子。

ex.en: I got an automated message instead of a real person.
ex.zh: 我收到的是自動訊息，不是真人回覆。

ex.en: She has a calm aura that makes people feel relaxed.
ex.zh: 她有一種沉穩的氣場，讓人感到放鬆。

ex.en: The old house had an aura of mystery.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子散發著神祕的氛圍。

ex.en: Experts checked the painting to confirm its authenticity.
ex.zh: 專家檢查了這幅畫，確認它的真實性。

ex.en: Many travelers want the authenticity of local food, not tourist menus.
ex.zh: 許多旅人想吃到道地的在地美食，而不是觀光客菜單。

ex.zh: 她做了夜間工作來增加收入。

ex.zh: 學校打算用新書擴充圖書館。

ex.en: Extra lessons can augment what students learn in class.
ex.zh: 額外的課程能補充學生在課堂上學到的東西。

ex.en: The singer gave me her autograph after the show.
ex.zh: 演出結束後，那位歌手給了我她的親筆簽名。

ex.en: He keeps a baseball with the autograph of his hero.
ex.zh: 他珍藏著一顆有偶像簽名的棒球。

ex.en: The author autographed copies of her new book.
ex.zh: 作者在她的新書上簽了名。

ex.zh: 粉絲們排隊等著請人在海報上簽名。

ex.zh: 自閉症會影響一個人溝通與和他人互動的方式。

ex.zh: 學校為自閉症兒童提供額外的支持。

ex.zh: 這場音樂會由市議會主辦。

ex.en: The research was carried out under the auspices of the university.
ex.zh: 這項研究是在大學的支持下進行的。

ex.en: Her voice was barely audible over the noise.
ex.zh: 在噪音中，她的聲音幾乎聽不見。

ex.zh: 房間後面傳來一聲聽得見的嘆息。

ex.zh: 隔著三層樓都聽得到警報聲。

ex.en: Only authorised staff may enter this room.
ex.zh: 只有經授權的員工才能進入這個房間。

ex.en: Please buy tickets from an authorised seller.
ex.zh: 請向授權的販售商購買票券。

ex.en: The manager authorised the refund yesterday.
ex.zh: 經理昨天核准了這筆退款。

ex.en: The council authorised a new bus route last year.
ex.zh: 市議會去年批准了一條新的公車路線。

ex.en: Loud noise can damage the auditory nerve.
ex.zh: 巨大的噪音可能傷害聽覺神經。

ex.en: Some students learn better through auditory methods like lectures.
ex.zh: 有些學生透過演講這類聽覺方式學得更好。

ex.en: Auditing helps companies make sure their records are correct.
ex.zh: 審計能幫助公司確認帳目正確。

ex.en: She works in auditing at a large accounting firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型會計事務所從事審計工作。

ex.zh: 她的第一本小說有一部分是自傳性質的。

ex.zh: 他寫了一篇關於在小鎮長大的自傳式散文。

ex.zh: 僧侶們在山中過著簡樸的生活。

ex.en: The room was austere, with only a bed and a desk.
ex.zh: 這房間很簡樸，只有一張床和一張書桌。

ex.en: You need written authorisation to enter this building.
ex.zh: 進入這棟大樓需要書面授權。

ex.en: The bank asked for my authorisation before sending the money.
ex.zh: 銀行在匯款前先徵求我的同意。

ex.zh: 沒有適當的授權，員工不能開啟這份檔案。

ex.en: The auctioneer spoke very fast as people raised their hands.
ex.zh: 大家舉手時，拍賣官說話速度很快。

ex.en: The auctioneer hit the table and shouted, "Sold!"
ex.zh: 拍賣官敲了一下桌子，喊道：「成交！」

ex.en: He auctioneered the old furniture at the village fair.
ex.zh: 他在村裡的市集上拍賣舊家具。

ex.en: She auctioneers antiques every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每個星期六都拍賣古董。

ex.en: Only authorized staff may enter this room.
ex.zh: 只有經授權的工作人員可以進入這個房間。

ex.en: This shop is an authorized dealer of the brand.
ex.zh: 這家店是該品牌的授權經銷商。

ex.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new computers.
ex.zh: 經理批准採購新電腦。

ex.en: My bank authorized the payment immediately.
ex.zh: 我的銀行立刻核准了這筆付款。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Aussie who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來的澳洲人。

ex.en: The Aussie tourists loved the night market.
ex.zh: 澳洲遊客很喜歡夜市。

auspice.zh: 吉兆；贊助、主辦（常用 auspices）

ex.en: The festival was held under the auspices of the local government.
ex.zh: 這個慶典是在地方政府的贊助下舉辦的。

ex.en: The research took place under the auspices of the university.
ex.zh: 這項研究是在大學的主持下進行的。

ex.zh: 我阿姨包的水餃是全家最好吃的。

ex.en: Aunty came to visit us during the holiday.
ex.zh: 阿姨在假期時來探望我們。

ex.en: The hospital has an auxiliary generator in case of power failure.
ex.zh: 醫院備有輔助發電機以防停電。

ex.en: Auxiliary staff helped during the busy season.
ex.zh: 旺季時由輔助人員幫忙。

ex.en: In the sentence 'She is running', 'is' is an auxiliary.
ex.zh: 在句子 She is running 中，is 是助動詞。

ex.en: The nurses' auxiliary helps patients with daily tasks.
ex.zh: 護理輔助人員協助病人處理日常事務。

ex.en: I found an old audiotape of my grandfather's voice.
ex.zh: 我找到一捲記錄著爺爺聲音的舊錄音帶。

ex.en: The teacher played an audiotape for the listening test.
ex.zh: 老師為聽力測驗播放了一捲錄音帶。

ex.en: The autocratic leader ignored everyone's advice.
ex.zh: 那位專制的領導者無視所有人的建議。

ex.en: An autocratic boss rarely listens to his team.
ex.zh: 獨裁式的老闆很少聽團隊的意見。

ex.en: He is an autistic child who loves trains.
ex.zh: 他是個喜歡火車的自閉症孩子。

ex.en: The school offers extra support for autistic students.
ex.zh: 學校為自閉症學生提供額外的協助。

ex.en: The book explains how authoritarianism can slowly take hold of a country.
ex.zh: 這本書說明威權主義如何一步步掌控一個國家。

ex.en: Students studied the history of authoritarianism in the twentieth century.
ex.zh: 學生們研究了二十世紀威權主義的歷史。

ex.en: The test checks your aural skills, not your reading.
ex.zh: 這個測驗檢查的是你的聽力，而不是閱讀。

ex.en: Music gives us a rich aural experience.
ex.zh: 音樂帶給我們豐富的聽覺享受。

ex.en: The authorship of the letter is still unknown.
ex.zh: 這封信的作者是誰，至今不明。

ex.en: She claimed authorship of the song.
ex.zh: 她主張自己是這首歌的創作者。

ex.en: It was an audacious plan to cross the desert on foot.
ex.zh: 徒步橫越沙漠是個大膽的計畫。

ex.en: The young designer made an audacious move by quitting her job to start a company.
ex.zh: 這位年輕設計師辭掉工作去創業，是個大膽的決定。

ex.en: She has long auburn hair that shines in the sun.
ex.zh: 她有一頭在陽光下閃閃發亮的赤褐色長髮。

ex.en: The auburn leaves fell slowly from the trees.
ex.zh: 赤褐色的葉子從樹上緩緩落下。

ex.en: Her hair was a deep shade of auburn.
ex.zh: 她的頭髮是深赤褐色。

ex.en: The painter mixed red and brown to make auburn.
ex.zh: 畫家把紅色和棕色混在一起調出赤褐色。

ex.en: He had the audacity to ask for a refund after eating everything.
ex.zh: 他把東西全吃完還敢要求退費，真是厚臉皮。

ex.en: It took audacity to speak up against the boss.
ex.zh: 要向老闆提出反對意見需要很大的膽量。

ex.en: Some autoimmune diseases attack the joints.
ex.zh: 有些自體免疫疾病會攻擊關節。

ex.en: She sees a doctor for an autoimmune condition.
ex.zh: 她因為自體免疫的問題在看醫生。

augusta.zh: 奧古斯塔（美國城市名，緬因州首府）

ex.en: Augusta is the capital city of the state of Maine.
ex.zh: 奧古斯塔是緬因州的首府。

ex.en: There is also a city called Augusta in the state of Georgia.
ex.zh: 喬治亞州也有一座叫奧古斯塔的城市。

ex.en: The novel has a strong authorial voice.
ex.zh: 這本小說有很鮮明的作者風格。

ex.en: The critic discussed the authorial intent behind the poem.
ex.zh: 評論家討論了這首詩背後的作者意圖。

ex.en: Breathing and heartbeat are controlled by the autonomic nervous system.
ex.zh: 呼吸和心跳由自律神經系統控制。

ex.en: Sweating is an autonomic response to heat.
ex.zh: 流汗是身體對熱的自律反應。

ex.en: The sunny weather was an auspicious start to the festival.
ex.zh: 晴朗的天氣為慶典開了個好頭。

ex.en: They chose an auspicious day for the wedding.
ex.zh: 他們為婚禮挑了個吉日。

ex.en: The restaurant cooks authentically, just like a family in Tainan.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳煮得很道地，就像台南的家常菜。

ex.en: She spoke authentically about her own experience.
ex.zh: 她真誠地談起自己的經歷。

ex.en: Experts were asked to authenticate the old painting.
ex.zh: 專家受託鑑定那幅古畫。

ex.en: You must authenticate your identity before you can log in.
ex.zh: 登入之前你必須先驗證身分。
